left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Newly diagnosed histologically proven locoregional oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) without evidence of distant metastases

OSCC  [OR] includes the subsites of oral tongue, [OR]  floor of mouth, [OR]  gingiva, [OR]  retromolar trigone  [OR] and buccal mucosa OR Recurrent  [OR] or persistent histologically proven locoregional OSCC that was initially treated with surgery alone

right.raw_text:
-  must be eligible for surgical resection
  -  greater than 18 years of age
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  prior immunotherapy  [OR] or treatment with another anti PD-1 agent besides nivolumab
  -  prior chemotherapy including cetuximab  [OR] or radiation therapy
  -  concomitant malignancies except cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma  [OR] or basal cell carcinoma
  -  unresectable primary tumor  [OR] or regional disease  [OR] or distant metastases
